name: Tomato and Egg Stir Fry
directions: Cut tomatoes into small pieces and finely chop the green onions
Scramble the eggs in a bowl
Heat up pan until medium heat, add the half the oil and scramble the eggs until cooked. Set aside
Add the other half of the oil on high heat and add tomates and scallions. Stir fry for about a minute add the water and cover for 5 minutes
Smush the tomates with a spatula to get the juices out and add salt, sugar, white pepper and soy sauce. Stir and cover for 3 minutes
Add the potatostarch back in and stir well. Then add back in eggs and add sugar and salt to tatse.
